axes.model_access:
Official model-selector page: auto routing (Auto smart routing ~0.5×), tiers (Ultimate ~2.0× deep reasoning, Fast low-cost quick)
or direct model selection, with the Credit rate shown before sending; the Lite tier only supports Auto/Efficient and a curated model list.
The official docs state you can bring your own API keys: after adding custom models under Settings → Models, the task/Agent/automation selectors can all use them (Custom Models page).
There are also two release notes — "model consumption reference factor adjustment notice" and "Lite model tier retirement notice" — factors and tiers change; the client is authoritative.
axes.runtime:
The official family page (What is Qoder) gives the product matrix: Qoder (an integrated agentic workspace), Qoder IDE (the Editor window for
AI-assisted coding / multi-file changes), a JetBrains plugin (completion/Ask/Agent/MCP/project rules), Qoder CLI (a terminal coding agent,
connectable to scripts and automation), Cloud Agents (a fully managed cloud sandbox: define Agent/Environment via API, start Sessions, stream results back),
QoderWork, QoderWake, Agent SDK. The official positioning is "agentic platform for real work" —
understand the task and context → plan → execute with tools → verify → iterate, an end-to-end loop.
axes.local_files:
The IDE/plugin/CLI forms work with local code and projects; the CLI's official line: "understand your entire codebase, write and modify
code, run commands"; Cloud Agents run in a vendor-managed cloud sandbox (official Overview: no building your own agent loop,
no managing the tool-execution sandbox, no managing long connections). Storage and retention policies for code inside the sandbox were not verified item by item.
axes.background:
Cloud Agents is the official managed surface: fully managed runtime, Sessions run in the cloud, results stream back in real time;
the Quest window in Qoder IDE (an async task workflow) was officially retired at 2026-10-15 23:59 UTC+8 —
the official notice gives a timeline and migration advice (move to Qoder or keep using the Editor window).
The CLI side's background/scheduled-task surface was not verified item by item.
axes.permissions:
The official "Access Permissions" page: pick the permission mode before sending a task / during execution, default Ask for approval (key operations request approval),
covering files, terminal, network and enabled tools; changing the permission mode does not change the task's workspace or execution mode.
The account system uses a qoder.com account; on the enterprise side there are Teams/Enterprise plan pages (governance details not verified item by item).
axes.fit:
Fits: one account covering the whole "IDE+plugin+CLI+cloud" agentic coding loop, the Repo Wiki/memory/Skills context system,
BYOK to add your own models, Cloud Agents running long tasks managed.
Does not fit: those looking for a domestic compliance narrative (the international line uses qoder.com accounts and overseas endpoints; the domestic line is Qoder CN — see the qoder-cn dossier),
or anyone depending on the old Quest window workflow (retired).
axes.name_history:
Qoder and Qoder CN (formerly Tongyi Lingma) share the Qoder brand but are two product lines: the domestic line qoder.com.cn (dossier qoder-cn),
the international line qoder.com (this dossier). The docs.qoder.com customer-case pages mention "Alibaba Qoder" and a
"Qoder workshop hosted by Alibaba Cloud", pointing at the same Alibaba umbrella; but the official docs give no cross-reference page on the two lines' relationship.

related: same brand, two lines: the CN line runs domestic models and the domestic-deployment compliance narrative, the international line uses qoder.com accounts and overseas endpoints; no official cross-reference of the two lines
both are domestic-gone-global coding tools with two lines: ByteDance is active on both its domestic and international lines — a useful contrast to how the Alibaba Qoder/Qoder CN lines are split
also a big-tech coding-assistant family (Tencent Cloud line) — compare each one's domestic compliance narrative and full-family form
